kebab_example: aliyun gpdb restore-branch --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project-id spb-xxxx --branch-id br-xxxx --source-branch-id br-main --region cn-hangzhou
name: RestoreBranch

parameters.help_en: The region ID. This parameter is required when you create a primary branch. When you create a sub-branch, the region is inherited from the primary branch by default
parameters.help_zh: 地域 ID。创建主分支时必须指定，创建子分支时默认继承主分支所在地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Supabase project ID associated with the primary branch
parameters.help_zh: 主分支对应的 Supabase 项目 ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The branch ID that uniquely identifies a Supabase branch
parameters.help_zh: 分支 ID，用于唯一标识一个 Supabase 分支
parameters.name: branch_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source branch from which to recover
parameters.name: source_branch_id

parameters.help_en: The point in time of the source branch to recover to. The value must be within the recoverable time window
parameters.help_zh: 恢复来源分支的时间点，需在可恢复窗口内
parameters.name: source_branch_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The LSN of the source branch to recover to
parameters.name: source_branch_lsn

parameters.help_en: The backup branch name. If specified, automatic creation of a backup branch is performed before recovery
parameters.help_zh: 备份分支名称。指定后恢复前自动创建备份分支
parameters.name: preserve_under_name

parameters.help_en: The client idempotency token that ensures the idempotence of retry requests
parameters.help_zh: 客户端幂等令牌，用于保证重试请求的幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

BranchId.description_en: The branch ID that uniquely identifies a Supabase branch
BranchId.description_zh: 分支 ID，用于唯一标识一个 Supabase 分支
